summary: BASTION_ENABLED=false smoke test — call served by the Policy Router but no session ingested by Bastion, as expected. Confirms the kill-switch is wired and decoupled from the runtime path; if Bastion were to lose backend, the Policy Router would keep serving traffic and only the observability layer would degrade. Why: SOC 2 §CC7.4 integrity controls require agent runtime operations to continue independently of monitoring infrastructure.
